title: World Cup Watch Party from Home 🍿⚽
script: The whole squad is here. Pizza on the coffee table, jerseys on everyone, snacks everywhere. Someone's already yelling at the ref. Someone else can't sit down. We're not just watching — we're living it. Every pass feels personal. Every near-miss has us on our feet. When the goal comes, the whole room becomes one. This is what fandom looks like. This is why we clear our schedules.
prompt_for_hailuo: Young woman with long dark hair, oversized team hoodie, sitting on a crowded couch surrounded by friends watching a match on a large TV [Wide shot showing living room watch party atmosphere, blue light from TV illuminating faces]. She suddenly jumps up from the couch, arms in the air, screaming [Tracking shot following her sudden leap]. Second clip: she grabs a throw pillow and clutches it nervously during a tense moment near the penalty box [Push in on her tense face, eyes wide]. Group cheers behind her, snacks scattered on coffee table, cozy living room lighting mixed with TV glow, cinematic, 9:16 portrait.
thumbnail_idea: Woman jumping up from couch mid-celebration in crowded living room with friends watching TV
visual_scene: A modern cozy living room at night bathed in warm ambient lighting and blue TV glow, team flags and banners on walls, cushions in team colors on couch. Young woman with long dark hair wearing an oversized team hoodie squeezed onto a crowded couch surrounded by friends, all eyes fixed on a large flat-screen TV showing a live World Cup match. Snacks scattered everywhere, pizza on the coffee table, friends yelling at the ref. She suddenly jumps up from the couch mid-goal, arms thrown in the air, screaming with pure joy, then clutches a throw pillow during a tense near-miss moment near the penalty box. Group erupts in cheers behind her, cozy warm atmosphere mixed with blue TV glow, portrait 9:16 framing.

specific_details: Young woman with long dark hair in a messy bun wearing an oversized national team jersey dress sitting cross-legged on a plush couch in a modern cozy living room at night bathed in warm ambient lamp light and cool blue TV glow with national team flags draped over furniture and banners hanging on walls, pizza boxes and snacks spread across the coffee table, two friends sitting beside her in matching team jerseys with excited expressions watching the screen as someone jumps up yelling at the referee mid-play, another friend unable to sit still pacing and gesturing excitedly behind the couch, warm living room atmosphere with blue TV glow and golden lamp light creating an intimate World Cup watch party scene, portrait 9:16 framing.
